# BeerJSON units

Source revision [`68e8748b9a3cfa516730f99d8e63701c168e37fb`](https://github.com/beerjson/beerjson/tree/68e8748b9a3cfa516730f99d8e63701c168e37fb).

This directory contains the upstream `json/measureable_units.json` and its MIT license. Both files are checked into Git as published. Brewery documents use the definitions in [units.schema.json](../../units.schema.json) with unit codes aligned to BeerJSON and constraints specific to brewing operations.
